title: UNIVERSAL Auto Translator with Two Way translation
features:
!FREE KEY IN DISCORD!

🖥️ PLATFORM SUPPORT:
• PC Only (Requires keyboard for keybinds)
• Untested on mobile (If you experience any issues, please join our Discord server)

✨ FEATURES:
• Seamless sidebar GUI (Easy to open and close on the right side, draggable)
• Hotkey [K] to instantly enable/disable outgoing translation
• Two-Way Translation (Select incoming and outgoing translation independently, you can choose)
• Jumble Mode (Chaotically randomizes the outgoing language)
• Seamless packet interception for fast message delivery
• Works universally across all games!

⚠️ NOTE:
• This translates both incoming and outgoing messages based on your settings.
• Performance and translation speed vary based on your network strength and ping.
